Hi Vera —

Thanks for agreeing to run a hands-on session with us for the POC. To make the session useful for both teams, we want to lock down: prompt review, routing profiles (latency vs cost), and a short load test (small ramp to validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior).

Proposed 2-hr windows (PST):
- Option A: Thu Dec 2, 09:30–11:30
- Option B: Fri Dec 3, 15:00–17:00

Agenda (high level):
1) 15m intros & success criteria
2) 30m prompt review & redaction checklist walk-through
3) 30m routing & model variant demo (canary + fallback)
4) 30m controlled load test + observations
5) 15m next steps / action items

Can you confirm which window works and whether your team can upload a small sample bundle (<= 2k rows) ahead of time? We prefer a CSV/JSONL with columns: prompt, expected_label (optional), privacy_flag. I've attached a sample_template.csv to this email.

If you want, we can provide a pre-signed S3 link or a Drive folder — whichever is easier. Also attaching our redaction_checklist.docx to reduce back-and-forth.

Thanks — if Option B works we’ll have Lauren and Logan on the call to run routing/playback.

— Priyom

Subject: Prep checklist: test prompts, routing profiles, and load window

Team —

Quick internal prep notes ahead of Friday’s session (we’re on Option B):

1) Test prompts / eval set
- Expecting a small eval (200 items) + a larger sample (~1k rows) for routing/load. Columns: prompt, expected_output, convo_id, privacy_flag, note. Priyom — please confirm the exact header names we want uploaded (we’ll validate in ingestion).

2) Routing profiles
- Logan: can you prepare two routing profiles in the demo project: "low-latency" (p50 target < 220ms; cost higher) and "balanced" (p50 < 350ms). We’ll show fallbacks to a cheaper quantized variant.

3) Load test plan
- We’ll run a 10-minute warmup, then a 20-minute ramp to 30rps, hold for 10 minutes, then graceful cooldown. Attach loadtest-runbook.md for exact curl examples.

4) Redaction sign-off
- Grace: please review Vera’s redaction approach when files land. We should run a quick automated PII scan (k-anonymity check) and report any disallowed fields back to them.

Attachments referenced: redaction_checklist.docx, test_prompts_v1.txt, loadtest-runbook.md (all stubs).

Thanks — I’ll also prepare a short demo deck (10 slides) that shows routing behaviour and fallback examples.

— Lauren
